blocks.text: Flight to Iguazu and the Brazilian Side of the Falls

provenance.rationale: Formed the assigned day heading from the verified Word flight to Iguazu and afternoon visit to the Brazilian side.

blocks.text: Day 4 · After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Iguazu; on arrival, your private driver takes you to your hotel. In the afternoon, explore the Brazilian side of the falls with your guide, following the scenic walkways and observation platforms through the lush rainforest, with breathtaking panoramic views of the cascades. With approximately one third of the falls in Brazil, this side offers an impressive perspective of their scale and power. Return to your hotel.

blocks.text: The Argentine Side of Iguazu and Devil’s Throat

provenance.rationale: Formed the assigned day title from the verified Word visit to Argentina and its explicitly named Devil's Throat highlight.

blocks.text: Day 5 · After breakfast, cross into Argentina over the Tancredo Neves Bridge and enter Iguazú National Park. Trails and walkways lead through the rainforest to a series of spectacular viewpoints, where you feel the power of the cascades up close, among lush vegetation and rainbows. The highlight is the Devil’s Throat, the most impressive section of the falls. Optional: the Rafain show, the Macuco Safari or the Bird Park (see Optional excursions).
